answer: In this PoA design, identity verification is bound to a Wesolowski VDF: each claimant must execute a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with every result depending on its predecessor. Simulating many identities does not make any chain faster: GPUs may duplicate hardware, but cannot parallelize a chain’s dependent squarings, so each clone incurs a minimum wall-clock delay. Consequently, even a glacier, dune, or ivory-themed sybil farm encounters the same physical time bottleneck.
